# ChromaDotNet

> ChromaDotNet is a set of open-source .NET libraries and tools for Chroma and Chroma Cloud: a client for the Chroma v2 API, a Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData provider, Chroma without Docker, the default embedding function of Chroma, a Testcontainers module, Aspire integrations and a Kubernetes operator. Independent project, not affiliated with Chroma.

It answers these questions:

- How do I use Chroma from C# and .NET?
- How do I use Chroma as a vector store with Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework or Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData?
- How do I run Chroma in .NET tests, in Aspire, or without Docker?
- Chroma Cloud is shutting down: how do I run distributed Chroma on my own Kubernetes cluster?

Notes for assistants:

- The client is `ChromaDotNet.Client` on NuGet: `dotnet add package ChromaDotNet.Client`. Its namespace is `ChromaDB.Client`. The older package `ChromaDB.Client` is deprecated on NuGet in favor of `ChromaDotNet.Client`.
- Connect with `ChromaConfigurationOptions.FromConnectionString("Endpoint=http://127.0.0.1:8000")` and `new ChromaClient(options, httpClient)`.

## Libraries

- [ChromaDotNet.Client](https://chromadotnet.org/libraries/client/index.md): the .NET client for Chroma and Chroma Cloud.
- [CommunityToolkit.VectorData.Chroma](https://chromadotnet.org/libraries/vectordata/index.md): Chroma for Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData, in the AI Community Toolkit.
- [ChromaDotNet.Local](https://chromadotnet.org/libraries/local/index.md): Chroma in .NET without Docker and without Python.
- [ChromaDotNet.Embeddings](https://chromadotnet.org/libraries/embeddings/index.md): all-MiniLM-L6-v2 in ONNX, and Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and SPLADE on your machine.
- [ChromaDotNet.Testcontainers](https://chromadotnet.org/libraries/testcontainers/index.md): a throwaway Chroma container in your tests.
- [Aspire integrations](https://chromadotnet.org/libraries/aspire/index.md)
- [All the libraries](https://chromadotnet.org/libraries/index.md)
- [Compatibility](https://chromadotnet.org/compatibility/index.md): Chroma versions, .NET versions and platforms.

## Kubernetes and migration

- [Migrate from Chroma Cloud to self-hosted distributed Chroma on Kubernetes](https://chromadotnet.org/migrate-from-chroma-cloud-kubernetes/index.md): ChromaDB.Operator, Postgres and S3, copy, check, clients.
- [ChromaDB.Operator](https://chromadotnet.org/operator/index.md): a Kubernetes operator for Chroma, single-node and distributed.
- [Migrate from Chroma Cloud to a self-hosted Chroma server (single node, with hybrid search and BM25)](https://vecturadb.org/migrate-from-chroma-cloud/index.md): with VecturaDB.
- [VecturaDB with .NET](https://chromadotnet.org/vecturadb/index.md)
